Problem: Write a function to rearrange positive and negative numbers in a given array using lambda function.

Tests:
assert rearrange_numbs([-1, 2, -3, 5, 7, 8, 9, -10])==[2, 5, 7, 8, 9, -10, -3, -1]
assert rearrange_numbs([10,15,14,13,-18,12,-20])==[10, 12, 13, 14, 15, -20, -18]
assert rearrange_numbs([-20,20,-10,10,-30,30])==[10, 20, 30, -30, -20, -10]

Write the t task named `rearrange_numbs` with 1 parameter(s) of type(s) seq, in the order the tests pass them, returning seq. The tests must pass and the ensures must specify the result.
